## 安装

**Docker Hub：**

```bash
docker pull yideng966/lightagent:vX.Y.Z
```

**GitHub Container Registry：**

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/yideng966/lightagent:vX.Y.Z
```

**完整技能镜像：**

```bash
docker pull yideng966/lightagent:vX.Y.Z-skills-full
```
